semantic_stage_groups.name: Offline Graph Construction
semantic_stage_groups.purpose: Offline Graph Construction: Build a Tri‑Graph from the corpus by splitting passages into sentences, extracting entities with spaCy, and creating sparse contain (passage–entity) and mention (sentence–entity) adjacency matrices.

semantic_stage_groups.name: Entity Activation via Local Semantic Bridging
semantic_stage_groups.purpose: Entity Activation via Local Semantic Bridging: For a query, activate relevant entities by initializing from matched entities, computing query–sentence similarities, and iteratively propagating scores through the sentence–entity subgraph with dynamic pruning to discover hidden bridging entities.

semantic_stage_groups.name: Passage Retrieval via Global Importance Aggregation
semantic_stage_groups.purpose: Passage Retrieval via Global Importance Aggregation: Use the activated entities as seeds for personalized PageRank on the passage–entity subgraph, initializing passage nodes with a hybrid score, to obtain a globally ranked list of top passages.
